## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach used to solve it.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`python -m pytest`)
- [ ] Python lint passes (`python -m ruff check backend tests run.py setup.py`)
- [ ] Frontend checks pass (`cd frontend && npm run check`)
- [ ] User-facing changes include screenshots or recordings

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Joint limits and emergency-stop behavior remain covered
- [ ] API or configuration changes are documented
- [ ] No secrets, runtime databases, or generated dependencies are committed
